fix_plan.description: Minimal surgical fix for ValueError: Cart subtotal mismatch on floating-point precision sum

files_to_modify.rationale: Strict float equality check fails on IEEE-754 binary floating-point representation

fix_plan.patch:
--- a/app/services/cart_service.py
+++ b/app/services/cart_service.py
@@ -10,6 +10,6 @@
     computed_sum = sum(item_prices)

-    if computed_sum != reported_subtotal:
+    if round(computed_sum, 2) != round(reported_subtotal, 2):
         raise ValueError(
             f"Cart subtotal mismatch: computed sum {computed_sum} does not match reported subtotal {reported_subtotal}"
         )
fix_plan.rationale: Strict float equality check fails on IEEE-754 binary floating-point representation
